markets.label: Brent crude oil
markets.blurb: Europe's benchmark oil price, daily (weekdays). Pushed up by the Iran war; a pure pattern model can't know whether the conflict escalates or ends.

markets.label: WTI crude oil
markets.blurb: The US benchmark oil price, daily (weekdays). Usually moves with Brent but trades at a discount.

markets.label: Bitcoin
